name: Iron Marshal
title: Switchyard Command Unit
biography: A heavy command robot with a cyan riot shield coordinates the smaller switchyard machines. Its enrage opens the magenta reactor vents and accelerates both firing patterns. Decorative shoulder emitters are part of its authored silhouette; this mini-boss uses recovery armor rather than the parent’s destructible-funnel gate.
weakness: Counterattack after either skill for ×1.5 damage; armor otherwise reduces damage to ×0.8.
origin: The Neon Switchyard, an original fictional PawTrail location

skills.name: Riot Sweep
skills.description: The shield arm marks a broad forward wedge. Circle behind the command unit.

skills.name: Siege Lock
skills.description: A shoulder emitter locks a blast disk at your last position. Leave it before contact.

review: Firefox 2026-11-12: model/pose scale, Riot Sweep 23 HP, Siege Lock 25 HP and 900-HP enrage art/cut-in observed. Full defeat and natural phase threshold unreviewed.
